evidence: Ter. Ph. 454: Quot hominēs, tot sententiae
terms.comment: Answered by tot: quot … tot, as many … so many.

terms.gloss: which in number? (what hour, how many in a party)
terms.comment: “What time is it?” is hōra quota est?, which hour in the count (see “what time is it?”).

phrases.english: how many of you are there?

phrases.latin: quaeris, quot mihi bāsiātiōnēs tuae, Lesbia, sint satis superque
phrases.english: you ask, Lesbia, how many of your kisses would be enough for me and more than enough

phrases.latin: Quot hominēs, tot sententiae; suus cuique mōs.
phrases.english: So many men, so many opinions; each has his own way.

phrases.latin: dīc quotus et quantī cupiās cēnāre, nec ūnum addiderīs verbum: cēna parāta tibi est
phrases.english: say how many you will be at dinner and what you want to spend, and don’t add a word: your dinner is ready
